import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(name,fun,p0):
    def resid(p):
        X=fun(p); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        return dP_dt-X@c
    s=least_squares(resid,p0)
    print(name, s.x, np.mean(s.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
